name: compact-recursive-carryover
note: A later compaction must pass the earlier summary through whole. Flattening it the way an ordinary message is flattened would cut it to one truncated line, so everything the first compaction paid to keep would vanish by the third turn — which is exactly when a long session needs it. Token-native gating compacts once before each follow-up, avoiding the old byte gate's redundant mid-turn pass.
prompt: align the greeting in service.py with settings.yaml
followups: what do you know so far
